map.label: Map of the track
map.addCheckpoint: Click to add a checkpoint here

profile.label: Elevation profile
profile.hint: Point at the profile to locate a position on the map
profile.noElevation: This track has no elevation data, so no elevation profile can be shown.
profile.hintPick: Point at the profile to locate a position on the map – click (or press Enter) to add a checkpoint

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.hint: Click the track on the map or the elevation profile to add a checkpoint, enter its distance or import the waypoints of the GPX file. Drag a checkpoint on the map or by its number on the profile to move it (Esc cancels).

openLabel.elapsed: Opening time of {{control}}, hours after the start

closeLabel.elapsed: Closing time of {{control}}, hours after the start

invalidTime.clock: Enter a time of day as HH:MM, e.g. 13:30 – add the weekday for another day, e.g. Sun 09:00
invalidTime.elapsed: Enter the time after the start as H:MM, e.g. 13:30

checkpoints.duplicate: There already is a checkpoint at this position.

windowsNote.clock: Control window: opening and closing time, pre-filled from the {{rules}} rules – edit them to match the route sheet.
windowsNote.elapsed: Control window: opening and closing time in hours:minutes after the start, pre-filled from the {{rules}} rules – edit them to match the route sheet.

import.added_one: Added {{count}} checkpoint from the GPX waypoints.
import.added_other: Added {{count}} checkpoints from the GPX waypoints.
import.tooFar_one: {{count}} waypoint is more than 1 km from the track and was skipped: {{names}}.
import.tooFar_other: {{count}} waypoints are more than 1 km from the track and were skipped: {{names}}.

checkpoints.moveTooClose: Too close to {{control}} – checkpoints must be at least 100 m apart.

controls.invalidDistance: Enter a distance between 0 and {{max}} km
controls.invalidLimit: Enter the time limit as hours:minutes, e.g. 15:00
controls.customNote: Custom brevet of {{km}} km: the finish closes after {{limit}}, the closing times of the other controls are scaled to that limit.

timetable.title: Checkpoints & timetable
timetable.invalidRest: Enter the rest in whole minutes
timetable.note: Speed and climb rate apply to the segment ending at the control – leave empty to use the plan's values. Buffer = time left until the control closes: OK, Tight (less than {{tight}} min), Early (before the control opens – you wait) or Late (after it closes).

settings.label: Start, pace and totals
settings.invalidStartTime: Enter the start time as HH:MM, e.g. 06:00

status.okHint: Enough time left until the control closes
status.tightHint: Little time left until the control closes
status.earlyHint: Arrival before the control opens – you have to wait

gradient.name: Road gradient
gradient.unavailable: The track has no elevation data, so the gradient can't be shown.

daylight.name: Daylight
daylight.note: When you are expected there according to the timetable, compared with sunrise and sunset at that place. Start time zone: {{zone}}.

start.title: Route plans
start.newPlanText: Upload a GPX track to start planning: mark the checkpoints, estimate riding and rest times and get a timetable with control windows.
start.listError: The list of plans could not be loaded.
start.howTo: To keep a plan, download it and put the .plan.json file together with its .gpx track into public/plans/ in the repository, then commit both files.

plans.nameRequired: Enter a name for the plan

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.text: “{{name}}” has changes that haven't been downloaded yet. Download the plan to keep them.

downloaded.title: Plan downloaded
downloaded.text: Save {{planFile}} in public/plans/ next to {{trackFile}} and commit it – the plan then appears on the start screen.
downloaded.trackMissing: The track {{trackFile}} isn't in the plans folder yet – download it as well and put it next to the plan.

errors.track: The track of “{{name}}” can't be read: {{reason}}
errors.unavailable: “{{name}}” could not be loaded – the plans folder is not available.
